column1: # Reconclave PoE-P4 partition table -- two OTA app slots plus otadata
# `fleet.ota.apply` (main.c) always writes to the *inactive* slot and only ever
# switches the boot pointer after the streamed artifact's SHA-256 has been verified.
# Replaces the stock single-app table (Phase 4 gap: this board previously had no
# OTA-capable partition layout at all). Sized against ESPTOOLPY_FLASHSIZE_16MB.
